text: Hmm, let me see... I'm pretty sure it's #W1234567. I ordered it maybe... last week? It was that bookshelf, the one I wanted to change. Yeah, I think it was around the 15th. The item number might be... I'm not sure, let me see here. And my zip code is 90210. Yeah, that should be right.
